SideSpeed 0.2.1 fixes the Apps screen header on TVs with a narrower layout, such as the Fire TV Cube.

## Fixed
- The "● Helper running" pill no longer wraps onto several lines. The TV's address now sits on the second line next to the maintenance status, and pills always stay on one line.

For what's new in 0.2.0 (SideSpeed optimizes itself, a baseline profile, a smoother app list), see the [0.2.0 release](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.2.1.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.1.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.1-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.1-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.2.1-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |

Each companion file is also attached under a name without the version, for links that always point at the latest release.

## Notes
- **Updating:** install over the old version. Your settings are kept. Updating stops the helper, so start it again (Google TV / onn: just open SideSpeed). SideSpeed optimizes itself again the next time you leave it.
- The companion apps have not changed since 0.1.0. The Android companion still reports version 0.1.0.
- Both APKs are signed with the project key, which has certificate SHA-256 `5d153f27c68102ff8245e8eb1c6c0a4d4a11d5e1976685824cecb0ce7108cc0c`.
- The desktop installers are unsigned. On macOS, right-click the app and choose **Open**. On Windows, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

See the [README](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed#readme) for setup.
